description: The LS2 HSM module is a multi-chip Cryptographic Module with firmware and installed in Host CryptoBind HSM and CryptoBind DSS. It consists of multiple firmware components, including an operating system, applications exposing services and interfaces related to secure key management, crypto operations, and policy management of the module.
